title: Waystones Guide: Tiers, Modifiers, Sustain and Failed Maps
summary: Waystones are the single-use keys to Path of Exile 2's endgame Atlas. This guide covers tier progression, how modifiers affect difficulty and loot, why high rarity is not the same as sustain, and what you lose when a map fails.
description: A source-linked reference for Waystones in Path of Exile 2: tier-to-area mapping, modifier value/danger matrix, sustain strategy, failed-map losses, and the T15/T16 pinnacle rules.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Endgame map item icon from Path of Exile 2 - a T16 map representing the Waystone progression pinnacle used to open Atlas maps

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: A Waystone is consumed to open one Atlas map, and you get one attempt per Waystone. Tiers 1-16 raise monster level and difficulty; modifiers add upsides (prefixes) and downsides (suffixes) that also raise Waystone Drop Chance.
calloutDetail: Sustain comes from drop-chance suffixes, Atlas passives and not dying - not from rarity alone.
A failed (uncompleted) map still consumes the Waystone and any Tablets slotted into it.

answers.label: Climb tiers
text: Run maps you can complete; upgrade 3 same-tier Waystones at the Reforging Bench.

answers.label: Sustain
text: Favour suffixes that add Waystone Drop Chance and invest Atlas points into quantity.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Dying in a map (loses the Waystone) and over-juicing mods your build cannot survive.

facts.label: Tiers
note: Each tier raises monster level and map difficulty.

facts.label: Use
note: Placed in the Map Device; consumed whether or not you complete it.

facts.label: Modifiers
note: Suffixes add downsides but raise Waystone Drop Chance.

facts.label: T16
note: Cannot be reforged; T15 can be corrupted upward to T16.

sections.title: What a Waystone is
intro: Waystones are the consumable items that open Atlas map nodes. They are the backbone of endgame progression: clearing maps grants Atlas passive points and unlocks higher tiers.

members.title: Standard Waystone
body: Normal / Magic / Rare Waystones open a map of their tier. Higher rarity means more modifiers.

members.title: Tower Waystone
body: Completing a Tower reveals the surrounding Atlas and guarantees a Precursor Tablet.

members.title: Corrupted / T16 Waystone
body: T16 is reached by Vaal-corrupting a T15 Waystone; required for Citadels.

properties.label: Tier
notes: Determines monster level and map difficulty. A Tier 5 Waystone pushes monsters to roughly level 70.

properties.label: Attempts
notes: Whether you clear or fail, the Waystone is consumed.

properties.label: Prefixes
notes: More monsters, gold, rarity, pack size. Generally beneficial.

properties.label: Suffixes
notes: Curses or extra monster damage, but each adds to Waystone Drop Chance.

properties.label: Waystone Drop Chance
notes: The stat that drives sustain; raised by suffixes, rarity and Atlas passives.

sections.title: How to get Waystones
intro: Waystones enter your pool from several places, and the goal is to keep that pool from running dry.

routes.label: Map bosses and rares
body: The primary sustain source. Bosses almost always drop a Waystone; rares and the map completion add more.

routes.label: Doryani / campaign reward
body: You receive a free Waystone after the campaign and skill books as you clear tiers.

routes.label: Reforging Bench
body: Combine three Waystones of the same tier and rarity to make one a tier higher (not T15 to T16).

routes.label: Vaal Orb (T15)
body: Corrupt a T15 Waystone for a chance at a T16; unpredictable but the only path to T16.

steps.label: Pick a map node
body: Choose a node you can clear with the tier you plan to use.

steps.label: Slot the Waystone
body: Place it in the Map Device box for that node.

steps.label: Traverse
body: Open the portal and run the map; it is consumed on entry.

sections.title: Modifying Waystones
paragraphs: Waystones take standard currency like any item. Orbs of Transmutation and Augmentation add modifiers; a Regal or Alchemy upgrades rarity and adds more; Exalted and Chaos Orbs push the modifier pool further.

Distilled Emotions can also be applied through the Instilling window (up to three), each adding a map modifier such as extra magic or rare monsters. Note that older guides claimed Waystones could not take Emotions - that guidance is out of date on the current client.
bullets: More modifiers = more Tablets can be slotted (0-2 mods: 1 slot, 3-5: 2, 6+: 3).
A Corrupted Nexus requires a Waystone with at least 4 modifiers.
Balance upside against the downside that comes with each suffix.

items.label: You can clear it
checks: Your build survives the tier and the suffixes on the Waystone.
items.why: Dying consumes the Waystone with no reward.
items.fix: Drop to a lower tier or remove dangerous mods.

items.label: Mods fit the build
checks: No hard counter (e.g. regeneration enemy, big elemental hits) for your build.
items.fix: Use a plainer Waystone for that node.

items.label: T15/T16 rules noted
checks: Citadels need T15; Corrupted Nexus needs >=4 mods.
items.fix: Prepare the right Waystone before the attempt.

rows.benefit: Steady Atlas points and basic sustain
rows.recommendation: Run to build the tier ladder

rows.scenario: T15 with >=4 mods for Corrupted Nexus

rows.recommendation: Only with a strong, proven build

rows.loss: Waystone and any slotted Tablets consumed, no completion
rows.recommendation: Do not over-juice; clear what you can survive.
Prefer suffixes that add Waystone Drop Chance.

rows.loss: Wasted if you cannot clear it

entries.question: Why do my Waystones keep running out even at high tier?
summary: A player had Rare Waystones but the pool still shrank.
editorialAnalysis: Rarity alone does not sustain; only drop-chance suffixes, Atlas passives and avoiding deaths keep the pool up.
officialAnswer: Add suffixes with Waystone Drop Chance and invest Atlas quantity nodes.

entries.question: Do I lose the Waystone if the map fails?
summary: Players unsure what a failed map costs.
editorialAnalysis: The Waystone is consumed on entry; an uncompleted map yields no completion rewards and loses slotted Tablets.
officialAnswer: Treat every Waystone as a single attempt; only run what you can finish.
